description: Who this product is built on, what licence each part carries, and what we do with it. The mechanical facts are here on purpose: a component that is neither imported, nor modified, nor handed to a customer cannot impose a condition on this product's own licence.

components.name: Slither
components.usage: Run as an external executable over a process boundary. Its output is read as JSON. Its source is never imported, never vendored, and never modified.
components.note: The only copyleft-licensed component in the stack. The product's own bytecode engine, CFG, resolver, feature extraction and model baseline are our own code and carry no copyleft obligation.

components.name: crytic-compile
components.usage: Reached only through Slither. It is not installed in this product's own environment and is never invoked directly.
components.note: Listed because it is part of what the Slither executable is made of, not because this product calls it.

components.name: Mythril
components.role: Symbolic execution, manual and on demand only
components.usage: Run as an external executable over a process boundary, on its own queue, never inside a default scan.
components.note: MIT, so the only obligation it could ever impose is that its notice travels with it if it were shipped.

components.name: FastAPI
components.usage: Imported normally, as a permissive dependency.
components.note: MIT. Its licence file travels with the package.

datasets.note: The weakness taxonomy and the join key between a detector and a published weakness class. Not yet ingested; the upstream layout is an entries directory, not a registry file.

datasets.redistribution: permitted with the notice and any NOTICE file retained
datasets.note: The intended evaluation corpus. Not yet ingested. The licence covers use and redistribution of the corpus with its notice; whether derived artifacts may be redistributed in a commercial product is the question still open for legal.

datasets.redistribution: permitted with the notice and any NOTICE file retained
datasets.note: Exploit proof-of-concepts, intended as the positive half of the evaluation corpus. Not yet ingested.

datasets.redistribution: unknown until each repository is audited
datasets.note: Each repository carries its own licence, so the dataset as a whole has no single licence. A repository whose licence is not yet determined is not a negative example, and its labels are not usable as ground truth.

note: This record covers the components whose licence bears on what this product may do. It is not a complete dependency inventory; the pinned requirements and their lockfiles are the complete record of what is installed.
